findings.location: Paragraph quoting Acts 27:20 (within second main paragraph)
findings.source_quote: ...when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away –Acts 27:20.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Spanish word 'tempestade' to the standard Spanish 'tempestad' so the quoted Scripture reads naturally and accurately in Spanish: '...se vino una fuerte tempestad; y habíamos ya perdido toda esperanza de ser salvados –Hechos 27:20.'
findings.translation_quote: ...cuando ni el sol ni las estrellas aparecieron por muchos días, y sobre nosotros se vino un fuerte tempestade; y habíamos ya perdido toda esperanza de ser salvados –Hechos 27:20.
